installation_absent.description: MuMu resolution found no MuMu installation: no configured folder, no running MuMu process, no usable uninstall registry entry and no vendor folder (count_kind installation_roots, count 0). A MuMu resolution reason reaches outcomes where the refusing step runs: check-config's MuMu note (a note link of check_config_passed when the MuMu folder cannot be resolved), provider startup's device failure at a start, and the failure of a capture or input open in a running Runtime. The context the resolution recorded travels as optional values when the emitting path has it: count_kind, count and count_known (what was counted, how many, and whether the count is exact), install_source (which resolver rung chose the installation), configured_adb_class, explicit_root and explicit_dll (how the adb, the MuMu folder and the capture DLL were configured), and mumu_root.
installation_absent.common_causes: MuMu not installed, installed in a folder the resolver does not search, or not running when the resolver relies on its process.
installation_absent.handling: Install MuMu, start it, or set mumu_root (or device_paths.nemu_folder) to its installation folder, then run check-config again.

installation_ambiguous.description: MuMu resolution found more than one MuMu installation root on one resolver rung and cannot choose (count_kind installation_roots, count the number found, install_source the rung). A MuMu resolution reason reaches outcomes where the refusing step runs: check-config's MuMu note (a note link of check_config_passed when the MuMu folder cannot be resolved), provider startup's device failure at a start, and the failure of a capture or input open in a running Runtime. The context the resolution recorded travels as optional values when the emitting path has it: count_kind, count and count_known (what was counted, how many, and whether the count is exact), install_source (which resolver rung chose the installation), configured_adb_class, explicit_root and explicit_dll (how the adb, the MuMu folder and the capture DLL were configured), and mumu_root.
installation_ambiguous.common_causes: Several MuMu installations side by side, or leftover folders of an uninstalled release.
installation_ambiguous.handling: Set mumu_root (or device_paths.nemu_folder) to the installation to use, or remove the unused installation.

shared_adb_multiple_dll_versions.description: The configured adb is MuMu's shared adb, and the installation holds more than one versioned Nemu capture DLL, so the version to pair with it is ambiguous (count_kind dll_versions, count the number found). A MuMu resolution reason reaches outcomes where the refusing step runs: check-config's MuMu note (a note link of check_config_passed when the MuMu folder cannot be resolved), provider startup's device failure at a start, and the failure of a capture or input open in a running Runtime. The context the resolution recorded travels as optional values when the emitting path has it: count_kind, count and count_known (what was counted, how many, and whether the count is exact), install_source (which resolver rung chose the installation), configured_adb_class, explicit_root and explicit_dll (how the adb, the MuMu folder and the capture DLL were configured), and mumu_root.
shared_adb_multiple_dll_versions.common_causes: A MuMu installation that keeps several emulator engine versions.
shared_adb_multiple_dll_versions.handling: Configure the capture DLL explicitly (device_paths.nemu_ipc_dll) or use the versioned adb of the engine in use.

configured_adb_identity_unrecognized.description: The configured adb does not identify a MuMu installation root, so it cannot be tied to the installation Nemu capture uses; adb and capture must share one installation identity. A MuMu resolution reason reaches outcomes where the refusing step runs: check-config's MuMu note (a note link of check_config_passed when the MuMu folder cannot be resolved), provider startup's device failure at a start, and the failure of a capture or input open in a running Runtime. The context the resolution recorded travels as optional values when the emitting path has it: count_kind, count and count_known (what was counted, how many, and whether the count is exact), install_source (which resolver rung chose the installation), configured_adb_class, explicit_root and explicit_dll (how the adb, the MuMu folder and the capture DLL were configured), and mumu_root.
configured_adb_identity_unrecognized.common_causes: An instance adb_path pointing at a generic adb (for example the install root's platform-tools) while Nemu capture is configured.
configured_adb_identity_unrecognized.handling: Use MuMu's own adb for Nemu capture, or choose another capture backend for the instance.

root_mismatch.description: A resolved backend file (the configured adb, the capture DLL or the folder of a running MuMu executable) belongs to another MuMu installation root than the one selected. A MuMu resolution reason reaches outcomes where the refusing step runs: check-config's MuMu note (a note link of check_config_passed when the MuMu folder cannot be resolved), provider startup's device failure at a start, and the failure of a capture or input open in a running Runtime. The context the resolution recorded travels as optional values when the emitting path has it: count_kind, count and count_known (what was counted, how many, and whether the count is exact), install_source (which resolver rung chose the installation), configured_adb_class, explicit_root and explicit_dll (how the adb, the MuMu folder and the capture DLL were configured), and mumu_root.
root_mismatch.common_causes: Two MuMu installations, with the adb or the DLL configured from one and the folder from the other.
root_mismatch.handling: Configure the adb, the capture DLL and mumu_root from the same MuMu installation.

dll_outside_root.description: The configured Nemu capture DLL lies outside the selected MuMu installation root. A MuMu resolution reason reaches outcomes where the refusing step runs: check-config's MuMu note (a note link of check_config_passed when the MuMu folder cannot be resolved), provider startup's device failure at a start, and the failure of a capture or input open in a running Runtime. The context the resolution recorded travels as optional values when the emitting path has it: count_kind, count and count_known (what was counted, how many, and whether the count is exact), install_source (which resolver rung chose the installation), configured_adb_class, explicit_root and explicit_dll (how the adb, the MuMu folder and the capture DLL were configured), and mumu_root.
dll_outside_root.common_causes: device_paths.nemu_ipc_dll pointing at a copied DLL or at another installation.
dll_outside_root.handling: Point device_paths.nemu_ipc_dll at the DLL inside the MuMu installation, or remove it to let the resolver find it.

dll_version_missing.description: No Nemu capture DLL carries the engine version (nx_device/<version>) of the adb or of the running MuMu executable, so the two cannot be paired. A MuMu resolution reason reaches outcomes where the refusing step runs: check-config's MuMu note (a note link of check_config_passed when the MuMu folder cannot be resolved), provider startup's device failure at a start, and the failure of a capture or input open in a running Runtime. The context the resolution recorded travels as optional values when the emitting path has it: count_kind, count and count_known (what was counted, how many, and whether the count is exact), install_source (which resolver rung chose the installation), configured_adb_class, explicit_root and explicit_dll (how the adb, the MuMu folder and the capture DLL were configured), and mumu_root.
dll_version_missing.common_causes: A capture DLL configured from outside the versioned engine folder, or an engine version whose DLL is missing.
dll_version_missing.handling: Configure the DLL of the engine version in use, or repair the MuMu installation.

version_mismatch.description: The adb (or the running MuMu executable) and the Nemu capture DLL carry different engine versions (nx_device/<version>); they must match. A MuMu resolution reason reaches outcomes where the refusing step runs: check-config's MuMu note (a note link of check_config_passed when the MuMu folder cannot be resolved), provider startup's device failure at a start, and the failure of a capture or input open in a running Runtime. The context the resolution recorded travels as optional values when the emitting path has it: count_kind, count and count_known (what was counted, how many, and whether the count is exact), install_source (which resolver rung chose the installation), configured_adb_class, explicit_root and explicit_dll (how the adb, the MuMu folder and the capture DLL were configured), and mumu_root.
version_mismatch.common_causes: A MuMu update that left an older adb or DLL configured, or files configured from two engine versions.
version_mismatch.handling: Configure the adb and the capture DLL of the same engine version, or remove the explicit paths to let the resolver pair them.

candidate_absent.description: The selected MuMu installation holds none of the candidate files the resolver checks for a needed backend file (the capture DLL, the adb or MuMuManager.exe; count_kind names which, count 0). A MuMu resolution reason reaches outcomes where the refusing step runs: check-config's MuMu note (a note link of check_config_passed when the MuMu folder cannot be resolved), provider startup's device failure at a start, and the failure of a capture or input open in a running Runtime. candidate_absent.common_causes: An incomplete or partly removed MuMu installation, or a MuMu release with another folder layout.
candidate_absent.handling: Repair or reinstall MuMu, or configure the file's path explicitly.

candidate_outside_root.description: A backend file candidate (capture DLL, adb or MuMuManager.exe) resolved outside the selected MuMu installation root, for example through a link. A MuMu resolution reason reaches outcomes where the refusing step runs: check-config's MuMu note (a note link of check_config_passed when the MuMu folder cannot be resolved), provider startup's device failure at a start, and the failure of a capture or input open in a running Runtime. candidate_outside_root.common_causes: A symbolic link or junction inside the MuMu folder that points elsewhere.
candidate_outside_root.handling: Remove the link and keep the files inside the MuMu installation, or configure the path explicitly.

running_executable_topology_invalid.description: The selected running MuMu executable's path does not show an installation root, so the installation cannot be derived from it (install_source running_process). A MuMu resolution reason reaches outcomes where the refusing step runs: check-config's MuMu note (a note link of check_config_passed when the MuMu folder cannot be resolved), provider startup's device failure at a start, and the failure of a capture or input open in a running Runtime. running_executable_topology_invalid.common_causes: MuMu started from a copied or unusual folder layout.
running_executable_topology_invalid.handling: Set mumu_root to the installation folder, or start MuMu from its installation.

running_version_missing.description: The selected running MuMu executable's path has no engine version folder (nx_device/<version>), so the capture DLL cannot be paired with it. A MuMu resolution reason reaches outcomes where the refusing step runs: check-config's MuMu note (a note link of check_config_passed when the MuMu folder cannot be resolved), provider startup's device failure at a start, and the failure of a capture or input open in a running Runtime. running_version_missing.common_causes: A MuMu release with another folder layout, or an executable started from outside the versioned engine folder.
running_version_missing.handling: Configure the capture DLL explicitly, or start the emulator from its installation.

target_identity_unavailable.description: No MuMu instance id can be derived for the target from its adb serial, and none is configured. A MuMu resolution reason reaches outcomes where the refusing step runs: check-config's MuMu note (a note link of check_config_passed when the MuMu folder cannot be resolved), provider startup's device failure at a start, and the failure of a capture or input open in a running Runtime. target_identity_unavailable.common_causes: An instance whose serial is not one of MuMu's local port serials, for example a handset or a renamed endpoint.
target_identity_unavailable.handling: Use the MuMu endpoint MuMu assigns to the instance, bind the instance by discovery, or choose another capture backend.

target_identity_invalid.description: The target instance's explicit MuMu instance id is out of range. A MuMu resolution reason reaches outcomes where the refusing step runs: check-config's MuMu note (a note link of check_config_passed when the MuMu folder cannot be resolved), provider startup's device failure at a start, and the failure of a capture or input open in a running Runtime. target_identity_invalid.common_causes: A negative or too large instance id in the configuration.
target_identity_invalid.handling: Correct the instance's MuMu instance id or bind the instance by discovery.

target_identity_mismatch.description: The instance id the target's serial implies and the explicit MuMu instance id differ. A MuMu resolution reason reaches outcomes where the refusing step runs: check-config's MuMu note (a note link of check_config_passed when the MuMu folder cannot be resolved), provider startup's device failure at a start, and the failure of a capture or input open in a running Runtime. target_identity_mismatch.common_causes: An instance id kept after the instance's port changed, or a serial of another instance.
target_identity_mismatch.handling: Make the endpoint and the instance id name the same MuMu instance, or bind the instance by discovery.

target_process_absent.description: No running MuMu device process matches the target instance (count_kind matched_target_processes, count 0, install_source running_process). A MuMu resolution reason reaches outcomes where the refusing step runs: check-config's MuMu note (a note link of check_config_passed when the MuMu folder cannot be resolved), provider startup's device failure at a start, and the failure of a capture or input open in a running Runtime. target_process_absent.common_causes: The emulator instance is stopped, or it runs under another account.
target_process_absent.handling: Start the emulator instance, then retry.

target_process_ambiguous.description: More than one running MuMu device process matches the target instance (count_kind matched_target_processes, count a lower bound: count_known false). target_process_ambiguous.common_causes: Several MuMu installations or engine versions running the same instance number.
target_process_ambiguous.handling: Stop the duplicate emulator processes, or set mumu_root to the installation to use.

target_executable_missing.description: The running MuMu device process of the target has no readable executable path, so its installation cannot be derived (count_kind matched_target_processes, count 1). A MuMu resolution reason reaches outcomes where the refusing step runs: check-config's MuMu note (a note link of check_config_passed when the MuMu folder cannot be resolved), provider startup's device failure at a start, and the failure of a capture or input open in a running Runtime. target_executable_missing.common_causes: The process runs elevated or under another account, so its path cannot be read.
target_executable_missing.handling: Run the emulator and the Runtime as the same user and elevation, or set mumu_root.

capture_identity_uncoordinated.description: Nemu capture has no coordinated MuMu installation identity (folder and DLL) to open with, because the resolution that should have supplied it did not. A MuMu resolution reason reaches outcomes where the refusing step runs: check-config's MuMu note (a note link of check_config_passed when the MuMu folder cannot be resolved), provider startup's device failure at a start, and the failure of a capture or input open in a running Runtime. The context the resolution recorded travels as optional values when the emitting path has it: count_kind, count and count_known (what was counted, how many, and whether the count is exact), install_source (which resolver rung chose the installation), configured_adb_class, explicit_root and explicit_dll (how the adb, the MuMu folder and the capture DLL were configured), and mumu_root.
capture_identity_uncoordinated.common_causes: A capture backend opened before or without the installation resolution, after an earlier resolution failure.
capture_identity_uncoordinated.handling: Resolve the earlier MuMu failure (see the instance's other outcomes), then reconnect the instance.

provider_version_below_minimum.description: The version MuMuManager reports is below the Runtime's minimum supported version (a Runtime policy floor, not a vendor minimum). A MuMu resolution reason reaches outcomes where the refusing step runs: check-config's MuMu note (a note link of check_config_passed when the MuMu folder cannot be resolved), provider startup's device failure at a start, and the failure of a capture or input open in a running Runtime. The context the resolution recorded travels as optional values when the emitting path has it: count_kind, count and count_known (what was counted, how many, and whether the count is exact), install_source (which resolver rung chose the installation), configured_adb_class, explicit_root and explicit_dll (how the adb, the MuMu folder and the capture DLL were configured), and mumu_root.
provider_version_below_minimum.handling: Update MuMu to a supported release.

provider_version_unparseable.description: MuMuManager's version answer is not a four-part numeric version. A MuMu resolution reason reaches outcomes where the refusing step runs: check-config's MuMu note (a note link of check_config_passed when the MuMu folder cannot be resolved), provider startup's device failure at a start, and the failure of a capture or input open in a running Runtime. The context the resolution recorded travels as optional values when the emitting path has it: count_kind, count and count_known (what was counted, how many, and whether the count is exact), install_source (which resolver rung chose the installation), configured_adb_class, explicit_root and explicit_dll (how the adb, the MuMu folder and the capture DLL were configured), and mumu_root.
provider_version_unparseable.common_causes: A MuMu release whose version output changed, or a damaged MuMuManager answer.
provider_version_unparseable.handling: Update MuMu to a supported release; report the version text if it repeats.

registry_source_unavailable.description: The Windows uninstall registry, one rung of MuMu resolution, cannot be read on this platform (install_source registry_uninstall). A MuMu resolution reason reaches outcomes where the refusing step runs: check-config's MuMu note (a note link of check_config_passed when the MuMu folder cannot be resolved), provider startup's device failure at a start, and the failure of a capture or input open in a running Runtime. The context the resolution recorded travels as optional values when the emitting path has it: count_kind, count and count_known (what was counted, how many, and whether the count is exact), install_source (which resolver rung chose the installation), configured_adb_class, explicit_root and explicit_dll (how the adb, the MuMu folder and the capture DLL were configured), and mumu_root.
registry_source_unavailable.common_causes: A platform without the Windows registry, or registry access denied.
registry_source_unavailable.handling: Set mumu_root to the installation folder so the registry is not needed.

registry_entry_invalid.description: A MuMuPlayer uninstall registry entry carries no usable install location, or a value of a type the resolver does not read (install_source registry_uninstall). A MuMu resolution reason reaches outcomes where the refusing step runs: check-config's MuMu note (a note link of check_config_passed when the MuMu folder cannot be resolved), provider startup's device failure at a start, and the failure of a capture or input open in a running Runtime. The context the resolution recorded travels as optional values when the emitting path has it: count_kind, count and count_known (what was counted, how many, and whether the count is exact), install_source (which resolver rung chose the installation), configured_adb_class, explicit_root and explicit_dll (how the adb, the MuMu folder and the capture DLL were configured), and mumu_root.
registry_entry_invalid.common_causes: A damaged or partial uninstall entry left by an interrupted install or uninstall.
registry_entry_invalid.handling: Repair or reinstall MuMu, or set mumu_root to the installation folder.

scrcpy_server_digest_mismatch.description: #402 RD-3: the scrcpy server the executable carries does not match the SHA-256 pinned in scripts/windows-tools/windows-tool-sources.v1.json, or the build embedded none; the scrcpy capture backend of the instance that opens it does not open, and the server is never pushed to the device. A damaged or incomplete installation. Only that instance's scrcpy capture backend is unavailable; the Runtime goes on (coordinator ruling 10-13, board #403 direction).

scrcpy_server_start_failed.description: #402 RD-3: the scrcpy capture backend could not start: pushing the server, the adb forward, starting the server, connecting to it, its stream header or its first frame failed within the start timeout. The open fails as capture_backend_open_failed. Only that instance's run fails and the recovery ladder handles it; the Runtime goes on (coordinator ruling 10-13, the instance-level rule of board #403).

scrcpy_stream_ended.description: #402 RD-3: the scrcpy video stream stopped: the server exited, the socket closed, a packet was malformed or H.264 decoding failed. No frame is delivered from a stream that ended; the capture fails instead of falling back to another backend. Only that instance's run fails and the recovery ladder handles it; the Runtime goes on (coordinator ruling 10-13, the instance-level rule of board #403).

scrcpy_video_size_mismatch.description: #402 RD-3: the scrcpy stream's video size is not the unscaled size requested (the display, or its centred crop to the size alignment), so its frames would be scaled; the stream is refused instead of downsampled. When it happens at the start, the open fails as capture_backend_open_failed. Only that instance's run fails and the recovery ladder handles it; the Runtime goes on (coordinator ruling 10-13 09:2x: every scrcpy code is instance-level).

capture_frame_stale.description: #398 R1 RD-3i: a stream capture backend received no frame encoded after the capture floor (the completion of the last input, or the frame delivered last) within its fresh wait; the step makes no input.

device_state_unreadable.description: A device-state read of a handset (model-398 section 7.1) failed, or its answer has a shape the parser does not know; device_state_probe names the read. When adb answered, the foreign_adb_error link keeps adb's failure output or the answer that could not be read; when adb could not run or did not finish there is no link. The state is never guessed.
device_state_unreadable.common_causes: The phone left adb (unplugged, offline, unauthorized); the phone vendor prints another dumpsys format than the parser knows.
device_state_unreadable.handling: Check the device link; for an unknown shape, add a neutral sample of the new format to the parser.

device_wake_failed.description: The handset's screen was still not awake after one KEYCODE_WAKEUP and the configured settle time (device_state.wake_settle_ms). The run does not start and no other input is sent.
device_wake_failed.common_causes: The settle time is shorter than the phone needs to turn the screen on; the wake key failed.
device_wake_failed.handling: Raise device_state.wake_settle_ms, or check the phone.

device_keyguard_dismiss_failed.description: A keyguard without a credential still showed on the handset after one wm dismiss-keyguard and the settle time. The run does not start.
device_keyguard_dismiss_failed.common_causes: The phone does not dismiss its keyguard from the shell.
device_keyguard_dismiss_failed.handling: Set device_state.keyguard_insecure to wait, or remove the keyguard on the phone.

device_locked.description: A keyguard waits for a person on the handset: it asks for a credential (PIN, pattern, password or biometric), or it asks for none and device_state.keyguard_insecure is wait. The code covers "locked, and a person is needed", whether because of a secure lock or the wait policy. Nothing is sent; the Runtime never enters a credential.
device_locked.common_causes: The phone locked itself after its screen timeout.

ensure_device.description: Device layer step: confirming that the adb target answers device (adb get-state, with one connect attempt when allowed) before a backend opens or a capture runs.

screen_size.description: Step of the adb shell input backend's connect: reading the screen size.

bounds_conversion.description: Step of the adb shell input backend's connect: turning the screen size into touch bounds.

device_rotation.description: Step of the adb shell input backend's connect: reading the display rotation.

bounds_validate.description: Operation of the adb shell input backend's connect: deriving and validating the touch bounds.

installation_resolve.description: Nemu capture operation: resolving the MuMu installation (root, adb and capture DLL).

capture_identity.description: Nemu capture operation: coordinating the capture's MuMu installation identity with the target and its adb.

target_resolve.description: Nemu capture operation: resolving the running MuMu device process of the target instance.

segmented_swipe.description: Input operation: a segmented swipe; the capability check refuses it when the selected input backend does not support it.

rotation_resolve.description: Operation of the adb shell input backend's connect that the device error's diagnostic context names when the display rotation cannot be resolved.

adb_ensure_device_get_state.description: Device stage: adb get-state while confirming that the target answers device.

adb_input_bounds_validate.description: Device stage: the adb shell input backend reading or validating the touch bounds, or refusing an action outside them.

adb_input_rotation_resolve.description: Device stage: the adb shell input backend resolving the display rotation at connect.

capture_frame_layout.description: Device stage: validating a captured frame's dimensions and pixel buffer length.

capture_scrcpy_config.description: Device stage: the scrcpy capture backend's configuration check before it starts.

capture_scrcpy_connect.description: Device stage: connecting to the scrcpy server's sockets.

capture_scrcpy_crop.description: Device stage: computing the scrcpy capture crop from the display size.

capture_scrcpy_first_frame.description: Device stage: waiting for the first scrcpy frame after the start.

capture_scrcpy_forward.description: Device stage: creating the adb forward to the scrcpy server or reading its port.

capture_scrcpy_fresh_wait.description: Device stage: waiting for a scrcpy frame encoded after the capture floor.

capture_scrcpy_header.description: Device stage: reading the scrcpy stream header (device name and codec).

capture_scrcpy_server_digest.description: Device stage: checking the scrcpy server file the build carries before it is pushed.

capture_scrcpy_server_exited.description: Device stage: the scrcpy server process exited before its sockets connected.

capture_scrcpy_server_local_copy.description: Device stage: writing the carried scrcpy server to a local file for the push.

capture_scrcpy_server_push.description: Device stage: pushing the scrcpy server to the device.

capture_scrcpy_server_spawn.description: Device stage: starting the scrcpy server process through adb.

capture_scrcpy_socket.description: Device stage: configuring or reading a scrcpy socket.

capture_scrcpy_stream_decode.description: Device stage: decoding a scrcpy video packet.

capture_scrcpy_stream_decoder_open.description: Device stage: opening the scrcpy video decoder.

capture_scrcpy_stream_protocol.description: Device stage: a malformed scrcpy stream packet.

capture_scrcpy_stream_server_exited.description: Device stage: the scrcpy server exited while streaming.

capture_scrcpy_stream_socket_closed.description: Device stage: the scrcpy video socket closed while streaming.

capture_scrcpy_stream_spawn.description: Device stage: starting the scrcpy stream reader.

capture_scrcpy_stream_state.description: Device stage: reading the scrcpy stream's shared state.

capture_scrcpy_stream_video_size.description: Device stage: the scrcpy encoder's video size differs from the requested crop.

input_nemu_capability.description: Device stage: the selected Nemu input capability is unavailable for the operation.

input_segmented_swipe_capability.description: Device stage: the selected input backend does not support segmented swipe.
